state_bit_order: bit 0 is the least significant bit
nibble_order: S-box j acts on bits 4*j..4*j+3, with bit 4*j as the nibble LSB
permutation_semantics: an S-box output bit at source position i is moved to destination P[i]
ddt_definition: DDT[a][b] = number of x in {0,...,15} for which S(x) xor S(x xor a) = b
trail_probability: product of the 384 local S-box transition probabilities

optimization_boundary.object: one characteristic/trail, not the aggregate differential hull
optimization_boundary.required_claim: global optimum over all valid 12-round trails
